```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(knitr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()

# Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013). The
# ids are the shared CFBD athlete namespace.
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who                 , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Arch Manning"       , "4870906"       ,
  "Nicco Marchiol"     , "4685459"       ,
  "Jordan Travis"      , "4360799"       ,
  "Cam Ward"           , "4688380"       ,
  "Trinidad Chambliss" , "4911529"       ,
  "Joe Burrow"         , "3915511"       ,
  "Malachi Nelson"     , "4870928"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Roster seasons of the seven quarterbacks through the last complete season.
# The season still being played is left out, so its usage cannot set a flag.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
ids <- subjects$cfb_athlete_id
ids_sql <- paste(sprintf("'%s'", ids), collapse = ",")
roster_rows <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf("SELECT * FROM roster WHERE playerId IN (%s)", ids_sql)
)
stat_seasons <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "SELECT DISTINCT playerId, season FROM player_stats WHERE playerId IN (%s)",
    ids_sql
  )
)
flags <- flag_redshirt(roster_rows, stat_seasons) |>
  select(playerId, season, team) |>
  mutate(
    playerId = as.character(playerId),
    who = subjects$who[match(playerId, subjects$cfb_athlete_id)]
  )
attempts <- tbl(con, "player_stats") |>
  filter(
    playerId %in% !!ids,
    category == "passing",
    statType == "ATT"
  ) |>
  transmute(playerId, season, attempts = as.numeric(stat)) |>
  collect()
player_games <- tbl(con, "game_player_stats") |>
  filter(playerId %in% !!ids, seasonType == "regular") |>
  distinct(playerId, season, gameId) |>
  count(playerId, season, name = "games_with_stat") |>
  collect()
covered <- tbl(con, "game_player_stats") |>
  filter(seasonType == "regular") |>
  distinct(season, team, gameId) |>
  count(season, team, name = "games_covered") |>
  collect()
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |>
  select(team, color) |>
  collect()

spine <- redshirt_spine(flags, attempts, player_games, covered) |>
  left_join(teams, by = "team") |>
  mutate(
    color = if_else(is.na(color), "#9CA3AF", color),
    text_col = label_text_colour(color),
    who = subjects$who[match(playerId, subjects$cfb_athlete_id)]
  ) |>
  filter(season <= complete_through)

p <- ggplot(spine, aes(x = season, y = who)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = color,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, %s, %d: %s pass attempts; %s games with a statistic",
        who,
        team,
        season,
        coalesce(as.character(attempts), "no"),
        games_with_stat
      ),
      data_id = paste(who, season)
    ),
    colour = "white",
    height = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = if_else(
        likely_rs %in% TRUE,
        "RS",
        coalesce(as.character(attempts), "-")
      ),
      colour = text_col
    ),
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(spine$season)),
    labels = function(x) paste0("'", substr(x, 3, 4))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Which seasons of these quarterbacks look like redshirts?",
    subtitle = "Each roster season in team colors; RS marks a redshirt-shaped season, and the number is pass attempts",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

card_thumbnail(p, "redshirt-shaped-seasons", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: career-table
# The roster records behind the timeline: schools, transfers and roster gaps,
# as the roster lists them (including the season still being played).
career <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf("SELECT * FROM career_summary WHERE playerId IN (%s)", ids_sql)
) |>
  mutate(who = subjects$who[match(playerId, subjects$cfb_athlete_id)])
career |>
  transmute(
    Player = who,
    Seasons = seasons,
    First = first_season,
    Last = last_season,
    Schools = teams,
    Transfers = transfers,
    `Missing seasons` = gap_seasons
  ) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Player",
      "Seasons",
      "First",
      "Last",
      "Schools",
      "Transfers",
      "Missing seasons"
    ),
    caption = "Career summaries from the roster records. Missing seasons counts years between the first and last roster season with no roster row."
  )
```
